notes.title: Making Scranny Free To Play!
notes.notes:
Hii, Everyone...

 Due to bad performance on steam We have decided to change the game from paid to Free To Play, we can understand It is a big decision. and to be fair with all the users who already own the game, we will be giving next part of the game (Scranny 2) for free, or we can give them gold pass for Scranny whichever the community decides.

 If you have any questions or suggestions please let us know.

Greetings Andy.

notes.title: The Graphical Update
notes.notes:
1. We have changed the graphical look of the whole game (we have changed the house, All the furniture, Scranny, Brob and most of the intractable items)

2. Added storyline and a trailer in the starting of the game which you can toggle on/off in the gameplay selection menu.

3. Added Ui to objects so its easier to find intractable items.

4. Removed randomness of the game and made it fix difficulties (easy, normal, hard, practice)

5. Added Breakable objects and Halloween themed items.

6. Fixed bugs and improved Scranny and brob AI.

7. Shotgun can now break the Security room lock without needing the security key.

8. Added better jumpscares.

9. Improved sounds.
